description: Minimal shared priors for relational embodiment, viability, support, action composition and temporal motor chunks, with receipt-grounded causal plasticity on the adaptive sheet.

attrs.description: Connected components, constraints, effectors and load paths are discoverable relational structure.
Interventions reveal delayed, state-conditioned causal influence.
Effectors may exchange momentum through contacts, wheels, reaction mass, thrusters or surrounding fluid; infer causal roles from receipts rather than body-part names.
Prefer useful task work per free-energy expenditure while respecting power, regeneration, heat and finite storage constraints.
Prefer predicted states that remain recoverable over merely instantaneously stable states.
Contacts may bear load, propel, pivot, brake or provide leverage.
Independent compatible actions may combine; interaction residuals must be learned from receipts.
Useful actions persist, terminate on sensed events and form receipt-grounded transitions.
Compose contact and free-flight capabilities across sensed phases: prepare, impulse, coast, arrest and recover are learned temporal roles rather than body-plan-specific commands.
Effectors with overlapping causal roles may substitute after damage.
Repeated safe trajectories may consolidate into reusable programs.

rules.name: emp_open_name_free_effector_assembly_hypothesis
rules.comment: Turn a mechanically published pair relation into a graph hypothesis. The boundary supplies path, channel and hard-coupling facts; receipts alone decide cooperation, redundancy or interference.

rules.name: emp_bridge_humanoid_program_members_to_generic_effectors
rules.comment: Expose every graph-authored program member to the generic assembly learner; this is relational normalization, not selection.

rules.name: emp_bridge_generic_program_members_to_effectors
rules.comment: Normalize arbitrary body-plan motor-program members into the shared effector assembly learner.

rules.name: emp_bridge_ground_trial_model_to_effectors
rules.comment: Normalize an opaque domain model edge; one command model may mechanically address several physical effectors.

rules.name: emp_bridge_aerial_trial_model_to_effectors
rules.comment: Normalize an opaque domain model edge; one command model may mechanically address several physical effectors.

rules.name: emp_bind_compound_trial_to_effector_assembly
rules.comment: Bind a compound intervention to every pair hypothesis whose two opaque members it actually enacted.

rules.name: emp_bind_vector_command_trial_to_effector_assembly
rules.comment: Recognize coactivation hidden inside one precombined opaque command vector.

rules.name: emp_reset_locomotor_continuity_on_episode_boundary
rules.comment: Consume an externally observed body/episode boundary while retaining learned priors and motor models.

rules.name: emp_reset_motor_energetics_on_episode_boundary
rules.comment: A simulator/body reset starts a new energetic accounting window while retaining learned effector capability models.

rules.name: emp_measure_locomotor_continuity_from_receipts
rules.comment: Track path efficiency, reversal and contact-cycle evidence from standardized raw receipts. These are graph state, not host-side gait labels.

rules.name: emp_measure_thermodynamic_motor_economy
rules.comment: Integrate measured actuator work, regeneration, thermal load and peak power in graph state. Dimensionless transport cost is derived from body weight and receipt-grounded path length.

rules.name: emp_learn_opaque_effector_causal_capability
rules.comment: Learn energy-normalized causal roles without assuming whether an opaque effector is a limb, wheel, rotor, thruster or aerodynamic surface.

rules.name: emp_learn_effector_assembly_from_compound_receipt
rules.comment: Accumulate continuous evidence for cooperation, interference, redundancy and common drive. Broad interfering assemblies reopen analysis by synthesis instead of becoming faults.
